status: proposal-only; no repository or source-cache edits, build, or tests

callbackAbi.slotDefinition: zero-based index in enemy.HandleAttack deferred for-loop over atk.Callbacks after nil filtering by QueueAttack/QueueAttackWithSnap; QueueAttackEvent receives explicit appended callbacks
callbackAbi.blockedMeaning: hitConfirmBlocked skips every hit callback, but applyDamage and OnTargetDied can still occur
callbackAbi.callOrder: damage applied (including OnTargetDied) then OnEnemyDamage, then ordered callbacks; child queues emitted by callbacks occur afterward

entry.snapshot: at skill cast; c.skillAtk pointer can be overwritten by a later E cast while older chain callbacks remain pending

topology.branching: each resolved enemy target callback on levels 1 and 2 independently chooses one random enemy within 10m; 0 child if none, 1 child otherwise; each queued 0.6m AoE child may itself resolve several targets

rootCallbackSlots.effect: enemy-only; closure done once; queues 3 or 4 Dendro particles

rootCallbackSlots.emitsAttack: 0 or 1 Universal Diagnosis per resolved target
rootCallbackSlots.delayFrames: 48 if selected target key equals current target key, else 54
entryFacts: baizhu.skill.next-present (0 or 1 from actual RandomEnemyWithinArea result)
baizhu.skill.target-changed (0 or 1, present only when next exists)

rootCallbackSlots.emitsAttack: 0 immediate; may schedule Spiritvein through shield lifetime
rootCallbackSlots.effect: closure done once per root attack; summonSeamlessShield

level2CallbackSlots.emitsAttack: 0 or 1 level-3 attack per resolved target
entryFacts: baizhu.skill.next-present (0 or 1 from actual RandomEnemyWithinArea result)
baizhu.skill.target-changed (0 or 1, present only when next exists)

topology.healing: if no next target, skillHealing immediately schedules heal +51; if level-3 child queued, schedules skillHealing at child delay then heal +51; no hit callback on level 3; multiple resolved targets can cause multiple heal tasks

gates.constellation0to1: attack topology above, no intrinsic event-triggered Splice; C1 adds second skill charge
gates.constellation2to5: OnEnemyDamage subscription can queue independent Gossamer Sprite: Splice at damage event before hit callbacks when active character damage and 300f C2 ICD allows; full E scope requires observer/event producer receipt
gates.constellation6: root C6 callback summons shield; existing shield may queue Spiritvein immediately and new shield expiry/break can queue Spiritvein later; full effect requires shield lifetime ABI
gates.hitConfirmBlocked: all callback slots skipped, so no chain, particle or C6 shield from blocked hit; separately instrumented OnEnemyDamage gameplay is skipped

blockers: Do not infer a fixed total of three attacks; each 0.6m attack can hit multiple targets and branch per resolved target.
C2 Splice is sourced by OnEnemyDamage, not a hit callback; C6 shield expiration/break can produce delayed Spiritvein, outside callback-only closure.
c.skillAtk is mutable character state, so subsequent E casts can change the attack template used by earlier chain callbacks.
families.proposedNarrowScope: baizhu-skill-chain-c0-c1: direct root and depth<=3 per-target callback-spawned damage, with exact next-present/target-changed facts; prohibit overlapping E invocations while chain remains pending because c.skillAtk is overwritten. Retain C2/C6 full-action gates.

families.display: Childe Q: Flash of Havoc / Light of Obliteration

entry.branchFact: meleeKey active at cast; ranged root center primary target radius6, snapshot/hitmark70; melee center player radius8, snapshot/hitmark69
entry.rangedSideTask: energy refund +20 at frame+4; not a damage queue
entry.meleeC6State: mlBurstUsed=true at cast, consumed only on future exit from melee stance

slots.effect: enemy target applies/refreshes riptide; at C4 newly affected target schedules rtC4Tick after 234f

slots.immediateChildAttackCount: one per resolved enemy target iff riptide active and slash ICD inactive, otherwise zero

gates.C2: OnTargetDied grants 4 energy for riptide-marked target, independent of Q hit callback
gates.C4: ranged application of previously unmarked enemy can schedule rtC4Tick every 234f while status active/source matches; this can queue Riptide Slash or Flash depending on later stance and is not finite immediate Q callback scope
gates.C6: melee Q sets mlBurstUsed flag; future onExitMeleeStance resets E cooldown rather than queueing damage
gates.ascension1: riptide duration extends from 600 to 1080 frames
gates.hitConfirmBlocked: callback batch blocked: no application or Blast from callbacks; OnTargetDied may still be emitted by applyDamage before callback phase

eventLifetimes.death: OnTargetDied for a riptide-marked enemy schedules Riptide Burst task +5, then attack snapshot/damage delay0; event fires in applyDamage before OnEnemyDamage and callback invocation. Thus lethal melee Q on a pre-marked target can schedule death Burst and then run Blast callback; must not merge or suppress either. Riptide Burst may apply riptide to nearby enemies and lead later deaths.
eventLifetimes.riptide: Ranged Q applies persistent status after damage; later player actions/deaths are not closed by an immediate Q attack graph.

blockers: Immediate Blast branch is callback-finite; full Q is not closed by callbacks because target death subscription and persistent Riptide/C4 timers can create later attacks.
Melee/ranged cast branch must be source observed; blast count cannot be guessed from pre-hit aura because status and slash ICD are read at callback time per target.
families.proposedNarrowScope: tartaglia-burst-immediate: direct Q plus per-target immediate melee Blast children, with Riptide/OnTargetDied/C4/C6 side effects explicitly excluded from damage-closed claim and recorded separately

entry.selectedEnemyCountFact: N = len(one actual EnemiesWithinArea result at firing); must be source observed from existing one-call selection, not recomputed from scene or log
entry.shotgunQueueCount: N, exactly one per selected enemy even if pellet hits=0
entry.pelletCount: 5+2*min(shrapnelAtFire,3), range 5..11; hits tested per selected enemy and used in multiplier
producerFacts: navia.skill.selected-enemy-count, recorded from the same EnemiesWithinArea slice used by the loop at fire time
navia.skill.arkhe-icd-active, recorded from the same StatusIsActive read that gates Surging Blade
entry.holdSupport: press hold<=0: frame11; hold>0 clamped to 241 and firingTime=40+clamped hold; producer receipt is at actual character-local fire time, accounting for hitlag.

C2plus.emitsAttack: 0 or 1 per resolved enemy callback when c2IcdKey inactive; adds 15f shared ICD before queue
C2plus.entryFact: navia.skill.c2-icd-active from existing callback StatusIsActive read; 1 implies zero child, 0 implies exactly one.

C2to3.effect: burstCB adds one shrapnel if burstICD 144f inactive

c2CannonCallbacks.sharedCallbackNote: burstCB and c4 are shared with Navia Q; generic callback body labels apply to both, and C2 lineage is established by parent queue IDs.

arkheTaskChain.timingNote: QueueCharTask is character-local and hitlag can postpone global-frame realization; do not assert fixed +64 global frames
arkheTaskChain.entryFact: navia.skill.arkhe-icd-active in navia.skill.fire producer row; 1 implies no arm child, 0 implies exactly one.

holdCrystalTasks.sideEffects: each scan can schedule shard pickup after ceil(distance/0.4) frames if within12m and arrival before firing/earliestPickup; picked shard can change shrapnel before fire
holdCrystalTasks.intrinsicDamageBoundary: The pull task and nested shard pickup queue no attack. Accepted pickup satisfies Core.F+travel < firingTimeF; shrapnel is read afresh by the fire task. Hold need not be gated for the intrinsic E damage graph, but shard/status provenance is a separate state contract.

topology.termination: finite per invocation for fixed scene: one fire task, N shotgun queues, at most one arkhe chain, C2 callback depth one; N is dynamic, not a declarative constant

gates.C0to1: shotgun callback slot0 only; C1 at firing reduces Q cooldown and restores up to9 energy from shrapnel
gates.C2to3: shotgun slot1 may add one Cannon Fire Support; per-shot closure plus shared 15f ICD, children may hit multiple targets
gates.C4to5: C2 cannon callback slot1 adds 480f Geo RES debuff
gates.C6: shrapnel after firing becomes max(shrapnel-3,0), rather than zero; excess shrapnel adds crit damage to shot snapshot
gates.classicVsStellar: stellar skill.go adds lcrShrapnelICDKey 60f to OnLunarCrystallize gain, classic handler has no such gate; do not share shrapnel-state assumption across lanes
gates.hitConfirmBlocked: shotgun target batch blocked skips particle and C2 cannon; its direct damage and other global events may still occur

blockers: Callback batch alone cannot certify E: root attacks arise inside unlabeled firing task with dynamic N selected targets, and Surging Blade is produced by two nested character-local tasks.
Full state effects include A1 infusion 240f, C1 resources/cooldown, C4 Geo RES debuff, C6 retained shrapnel, and external Crystallize/Lunar-Crystallize shard events.
families.proposedNarrowScope: navia-skill-intrinsic-damage for all constellations and press/hold inputs: require actual navia.skill.fire producer fact N, exactly N queued shotguns, actual per-target C2 callback batches, and source-observed Surging Blade arm/release producer path; pickup, A1/C1/C4/C6 state lifetimes remain separately represented by native simulation rather than claimed by attack-topology analyzer.

agreedApi: Core.SourceHostAbilityProducerFact(name,value) -> active AbilityProducer.entryFacts (new minimal API, no method-entry fallback)
requirements: Do not wrap closures or alter callbacks; labels at callback body first line.
Join children with callback row emitted queues by queueId/attackId, not attack names.
Ability producer labels and queue emit sites are additionally required for Navia firing and arkhe tasks.
Observe zero-child callbacks and blocked batches; absence of child is not proof of blocked or no-target branch.

preTalentInstrumentationCheck.note: 111 hunks avoid SourceHostTalentRead context; preinstrument source lacks current 108/110 site changes but these four source files still accept patch.

siteNotes: Baizhu first/second chain closure precomputes site label by count; does not wrap callback.
Baizhu child QueueAttackEvent uses SourceHostQueueHitAttackEvent with same delay and attack object; branch facts come from same random next target.
Navia fire uses one EnemiesWithinArea call saved to targets and records len(targets) to active producer, then iterates same targets.
Navia Surging Blade gate records existing arkhe ICD read inside fire producer and labels both character-local tasks.
Navia C2 records existing ICD read and tags queued Cannon Fire Support; shared burstCB and c4 bodies use generic cannon labels.
No Tartaglia Q site patch or contract registration, due OnTargetDied and C4 lifetime gaps.
No Baizhu C2/C6 contract enablement until event/shield lifetime evidence is represented.
neededAnalyzerContract: Use AbilityProducer.entryFacts at run time for Navia N and arkhe gate; do not read invocation.entryFacts for late values.
Require exact fire producer queuedAttack count N and exact arm child count 1-arkheICDActive.
Require Baizhu per-target callback child count equal next-present fact, and child queue frame delay 48 or54 from target-changed fact.
Require Navia C2 callback child count equal 1-c2ICDActive fact; use queueID/attackID lineage and generic shared cannon callback body labels.
Keep Baizhu C2/C6 disabled, Tartaglia Q unregistered; do not claim full state lifetime certification from an intrinsic-damage-only receipt.
